turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, we're having a very quiet Sunday. Portland is pretty chilly today, so we're mostly staying indoors. Olive is curled up on my lap right now. Today is a rest day for me, so I'm not doing any tennis or workouts, just taking it easy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A rest day sounds perfect for a chilly Sunday. It's great to hear Olive is keeping you company. How is your back feeling lately? Fully recovered, I hope?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, my back is totally fine now, thanks for asking. It feels completely back to normal. I'm glad I don't have to worry about that anymore.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful news. Did you end up doing anything around the neighborhood today, or has it been purely indoor relaxation?

turns.text: Mostly indoors. I did chat with our neighbor for a few minutes earlier. His vegetable garden is coming along, though there's not much happening with it in February! Other than that, just resting.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Haha, yes, February isn't prime time for gardening! It's nice to keep in touch with neighbors, though. Do you and Grace have any plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We do! We're planning to watch a sci-fi series tonight. We're going to use that new streaming service we signed up for recently.

turns.text: Oh, nice! A sci-fi series sounds like a great way to spend a cold Sunday evening. What's the show about?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's about a crew on a long space journey looking for a new planet. I've heard really good things about the plot, so we're excited to start it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds right up my alley too! I hope it lives up to the hype. Are you feeling ready for the upcoming week at school?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty much. Being the head of the science department keeps me busy, but I got most of my lesson planning and department prep done yesterday, so I can truly enjoy the day off.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's smart planning. It's always nice to have a Sunday where you don't have to worry about work. Have you and Grace looked at any of your Japan photos lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes! We were just looking at some of our photos from Kyoto a couple of days ago. It makes us want to go back. But for tonight, it's just couch time and that sci-fi series.
